d: Bangladesh's Chief Prosecutor has warned that ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina could face execution if she returns to the country. Hasina, who was sentenced to death in absentia for crimes against humanity linked to the 2024 protest crackdown, reportedly missed the 30-day statutory deadline to appeal her conviction. Prosecutors maintain that she can no longer challenge the verdict through the regular appeals process. Hasina has vowed to return to Bangladesh in December, raising fresh questions about her legal future and possible extradition.
